title: WorldSMP
description: WorldSMP — выживание с потерей сердец, крафтом легендарного оружия и прокачкой копья. IP: worldsmp.20tps.ru (1.21.11, русскоязычный)
body:
**# 🎮 WorldSMP – Survival with High Stakes**
_WorldSMP is a survival server where classic Minecraft meets real risk. No clans, no overcomplicated mechanics. Just you, the world, legendary weapons, and a unique heart system that makes every fight matter._

🌍 **Server language:** _Russian_
👥 **Majority of players: from Ukraine and Russia**
🧭 **English is not required – everything in-game and in chat is Russian-friendly**

**❤️ Unique Heart System**
_There are no infinite respawns like on ordinary servers.

When you die (from mobs, fall damage, lava, etc.) – you lose 1 heart from your maximum health.

When you kill another player – you gain +1 heart to your maximum.

Hearts don't regenerate for free. The more hearts you have, the tougher you are – but the higher the stakes in every battle. This system changes PvP and risk management completely._

**⚔️ Legendary Maces & Weapons (Craftable!)**
_Legendary weapons on WorldSMP are not random drops – you craft them yourself.

Unique crafting recipes for legendary maces, swords, and other weapons

Rare resources required – you must explore and mine to find them

Each legendary weapon has special properties (damage, effects, unique mechanics)

No luck-based grinding. You set a goal, gather materials, and forge your own power.
_
**🔱 Spear Mastery (Progression System)**
_A separate system for spear lovers. The more you use a spear in combat – the higher your level.

Spear progression gives:

Increased damage

Bonus abilities

Advantages in PvP against sword users

The spear is a full-fledged weapon class, not just "another sword"._

**🏕️ Simple & Fair Survival**
_We intentionally removed everything that gets in the way of fun:_

**❌ No clans** – _you don't have to join anyone_

**❌ No region protections everywhere** – _only spawn and the shop are protected_

**✅ Clean survival** – _build, mine, explore_

**✅ Minimum plugins** – _the server stays vanilla in spirit_

_No one forces you into alliances or dozens of confusing commands._

**🛡️ Where Protections (Region Flags) Exist**
**Spawn** – _protected so new players don't get griefed_

**Shop** – _trading zone_

**Everything else** – **no protections. The game runs on respect and common sense.**

**💎 Donation (Website)**
_The server has a donation system, but it doesn't break balance. Donation perks are about convenience and cosmetics – not "win with one click"._[telegram](https://t.me/Worlds_SMP)

**🎯 Who Is This Server For?**
_WorldSMP is perfect for you if:

You're tired of clan wars and forced alliances

You like risk-based systems (losing hearts on death)

You want to craft legendary weapons, not wait for random drops

You're interested in spear progression

You're looking for a server without wipes and with simple rules

You speak Russian or Ukrainian (or don't mind playing with Russian-speaking community)_

**No mods required. Just log in and survive.**

**Remember: every heart you have counts.**
